jobs.title: Salesforce and GenAI System Analyst
jobs.why: Excellent match for Audrey's Salesforce/business-systems track: CRM workflows, business-process analysis, requirements gathering, automation, system enhancements, and cross-functional partnership are central to the role.
jobs.gap: The posting prefers SQL/SOQL, scripting, or Salesforce certifications, so she should emphasize any hands-on Salesforce configuration and technical learning experience.

jobs.title: Business Systems Analyst, Sales Intelligence
jobs.why: Strong alignment with translating ambiguous business needs into documented requirements, process maps, user stories, Salesforce Flow, reports, dashboards, and collaboration with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
jobs.gap: Salesforce Administrator certification and CRM Analytics are listed, so certification depth may be the main competitive gap.

jobs.title: Product Operations - Associate
jobs.why: Very good product-operations bridge: cross-functional execution, onboarding workflows, platform configuration, testing, issue tracking, stakeholder communication, and partnership with Engineering map well to Audrey's systems and operations background.
jobs.gap: Financial-services, annuity, or insurance-platform exposure is strongly preferred, so she should position her transferable implementation and client/stakeholder work clearly.

jobs.title: Business Operations & Data Analyst
jobs.why: The role combines cross-functional workflow management, operational improvement, data/AI systems, and executive-facing work, making it a strong fit for Audrey's business operations and systems profile.
jobs.gap: The role is data-heavy and sits in blockchain infrastructure, so she should foreground analytics, reporting, Excel, and examples of learning unfamiliar technical domains quickly.

jobs.title: Product Operations Manager
jobs.location: Hybrid in New York City, NY
jobs.why: Strong overlap with cross-functional product operations, process ownership, execution, and systems thinking. It offers a direct path toward the product/business-operations work Audrey is targeting.
jobs.gap: The posting asks for 4+ years and manager-level product operations ownership, so she will need to demonstrate scope, autonomy, and measurable outcomes rather than only support responsibilities.

jobs.title: UX Designer, D3 (Design, Development & Delivery) Team
jobs.why: The role values Figma, prototyping, complex workflows, cross-functional collaboration, documentation, and data-informed design. Those areas connect Audrey's UX training with her business-systems background.
jobs.gap: Amazon requires 3+ years of design experience and an online portfolio, making direct professional design tenure the largest hurdle.
